name: idside-examples-node
//: The `file:` dependency is the one line that is not what you would write. It resolves the SDK from this clone, so that CI tests the code beside these examples; in your own project, `file:../../packages/node` becomes `@idside/sdk@next` and nothing else changes. npm symlinks a file: dependency and does NOT build it, so `npm --prefix ../../packages/node run build` has to have run first.
